claim_boundary: conditional one-step price calibration; no causal, structural, elasticity, supply, demand, or market-power claim

phi_bound_sensitivity.selection_role: robustness disclosure only; never selects the primary model

dependence.phi_inference: training-only plug-in estimate; no phi posterior
dependence.residual_sd: training-only plug-in stationary marginal residual SD

geometry_audit.state_scale: geometric mean price of reference-training rows

negative_control.name: causal_lagged_reference
negative_control.rule: replace each contemporaneous reference design row by its row four observations earlier without reordering responses

parameter: eta=log(lambda), where lambda is a dimensionless multiplicative reference-to-state scale
prior: eta ~ Normal(0, 0.5^2), equivalently a lognormal density for lambda with respect to d lambda

reference_fit.rule: for test position j, fit only rows strictly before j-16

score_uncertainty.method: circular moving-block bootstrap of paired origin-level score contrasts

test_information.scope: conditional one-step prediction, not an unconditional forecast when contemporaneous weather is unavailable

sensitivities: Gaussian OLS coefficient covariance propagated analytically
one-at-a-time symmetric AR(1) coefficient clipping bounds
